visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler with short black hair wearing a red long-sleeved shirt, a grey vest, and blue-and-white polka-dot pants stands on a concrete driveway next to a large red plastic basket filled with yellow starfruits. A red SUV is parked in the background, and the scene is lit by bright, natural daylight. (2) The toddler smiles broadly at the camera, revealing her teeth, while an older girl in a pink watermelon-printed t-shirt walks into the frame from the right. The toddler then bends down towards the grassy edge of the driveway to inspect the fallen fruit and leaves. (3) The camera focuses on the older girl in the pink shirt as she squats down on the green lawn. She picks up a starfruit, makes a facial expression of intense disgust, and quickly stands back up, while the toddler remains visible in the periphery near the driveway. (4) The toddler squats on the grass, carefully picking up starfruits and leaves with her small hands. In the background, the older girl can be seen riding a small pink bicycle with white training wheels across the paved driveway, moving from the right side to the left. (5) The toddler carries a yellow starfruit and walks back towards the red basket on the concrete. She drops the fruit into the basket with focused attention. The setting shows a suburban house with a garden, trees, and a wooden fence in the far background. (6) The toddler reaches down and grabs the sides of the red plastic basket. She exerts effort to lift and then completely flip the basket upside down, causing all the collected starfruit to spill out onto the concrete surface in a pile. (7) The video transitions to a clean pink background featuring a cartoon illustration of a young girl with pigtails in the center. Below the character, the white text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE' appears in a modern, sans-serif font, serving as an end card.
